page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.9 GHz, with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core. For graphics and accelerated workloads, it includes a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU allocation of 0.0833, delivering 2 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results position this instance primarily in the average performance tier across most compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1904.08 and a multi-core score of 7176.28. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1554.0 and a multi-core score of 5066.0, with solid performance in ray tracing at 6510.0 and software compilation at 6746.0. However, memory-intensive tasks show some limitations; the Passmark memory score is weak at 1651.18, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is rated poor at 21.1 GB/sec. Conversely, Redis SET operations remain strong at 8.23 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reaches 9.28 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the fractional GPU allocation allows users to access hardware acceleration without the expense of a full GPU, making it a resource-dense option for entry-level graphics tasks. The lack of local storage means users must provision external block storage, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. This instance is well-suited for lightweight virtual workstations, basic image processing, static web serving, and small-scale LLM inference, where the 135M model achieves 411.88 tokens per second for prompt processing and 111.74 tokens per second for text generation.
